input.title: Marshall Wace and Millennium hit in October AI rout
input.summary: Hedge funds Marshall Wace and Millennium suffered losses during an AI-driven market selloff in October 2026. The headline indicates broader hedge fund stress but provides no detail on magnitude or asset class.
